top_signals.title: Tankers Divert to Egypt as Houthi Threat Disrupts Red Sea
top_signals.summary: Empty supertankers are heading to Egypt’s Mediterranean port of Sidi Kerir to collect Saudi Arabia’s crude, a signal of wariness among some shipowners about sailing closer to Houthi-threatened waters.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: From steppe to sea, a Ukrainian drone unit hunts Russian ships
top_signals.summary: Drone units operating far behind the front line on Ukraine’s sweeping steppe have hit more than 180 vessels and other sea-borne targets in recent weeks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nasdaq 100 Nears a Correction as Chips Selloff Turns Ominous
top_signals.summary: The Nasdaq 100 Index is trading near a correction Tuesday as the selloff in semiconductor stocks turns ugly with investors questioning the amount of money Big Tech is spending on artificial intelligence.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: PayPal expands stablecoin push as crypto assets factor into Q2 results
top_signals.summary: PayPal highlighted growth of stablecoins and AI-driven payment tools in Q2 while reporting $8.68 billion in revenue and an $81 million crypto-related earnings adjustment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: EBay, former execs to pay $56 million in blogger harassment and stalking case
top_signals.summary: Ina and David Steiner run a popular ecommerce blog that had angered eBay executives due to its critical coverage.
